item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.5.1
item.description: Security and data-safety fixes from a full multi-agent audit: URL-scheme actions are confined to watched folders, a failed backup can no longer be followed by an overwrite, cloud-evicted sources no longer look deleted, the log can never be truncated, diagnostics can no longer re-arm the sync loop, hardened runtime is on, and the savings counter actually counts.
